project.title: Phosphoproteomic analysis of thermomorphogenic responses in Arabidopsis
project.projectDescription: To identify early regulators of plant thermo-responsiveness, we performed phosphoproteomic analysis using TMT (Tandem Mass Tags) labeling and phospeptide enrichment with dark-grown Arabidopsis wild-type seedlings treated with or without 3 hours of warm temperatures (29°C).
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: Stratified WT seeds were exposed to light for 8 hr and then were kept in the dark at 22°C for 2 days, after which the plates were kept at 22°C or 29°C for 3 hours and etiolated seedlings were sampled for further study with three biological replicates.  Proteomics analysis was carried out in the company PTM BIO (Hangzhou, China). Briefly, samples were ground with the lysis buffer (8 M urea, 1% Triton-100, 10 mM dithiothreitol, and 1% Protease Inhibitor Cocktail), followed by sonication three times on ice using a high intensity ultrasonic processor (Scientz). Total proteins were precipitated with cold 20% TCA for 2 h at -20 °C and redissolved in 8 M urea. After digestion with trypsin, peptides were desalted by Strata X C18 SPE columns (Phenomenex) and labeled with TMT kits according to the manufacturer’s protocol. For phosphoproteomic study, phosphopeptides were enriched with TiO2 (IMAC). The peptides were subjected to NSI source followed by tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) in Q ExactiveTM Plus (Thermo) coupled online to the EASY-nLC 1000 UPLC system.
project.dataProcessingProtocol: The resulting MS/MS data were processed using the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8) against the Arabidopsis TAIR database. The mass error for precursor ions was less than 20 ppm in First search and 5 ppm in Main search, and the mass error for fragment ions was less than 0.02 Da. Differentially regulated phosphopeptides were calculated and their corresponding proteins were subjected to GO analysis (Biological Process, Cellular Component, Molecular Function).

Comment[Instrument]: Q ExactiveTM Plus (ThermoFisher, MA, United States)
Comment[Separation]: home-made reversed-phase analytical column (15-cm length, 75μm i.d.)
Comment[GradientTime]: The gradient increased from 4 to 22% solvent B (0.1% formic acid in 90% acetonitrile) over 38min, 22 to 32% in 14min, climbing to 80% in 4min, and then holding at 80% for the last 3min, all at a constant flow rate of 350nl/min on an EASY-nLC 1200 UPLC system.
Comment[AcquisitionMethod]: A data-dependent procedure that alternated between one MS scan followed by 20 MS/MS scans with 15.0s dynamic exclusion.
Comment[MS2MassAnalyzer]: the fragments were detected in the Orbitrap at a resolution of 17,500.
Comment[PrecursorMassTolerance]: The mass error for precursor ions was less than 20ppm in the first search and 5ppm in the main search
Comment[FragmentMassTolerance]: the mass error for fragment ions was less than 0.02Da.
